name: 0002_alter_dataset_status.py
summary: Alters the status field on the Dataset model to update its database schema definition.
purpose: Propagates changes to the Dataset model's status field—such as new choices, default values, or constraints—into the database without recreating the table, ensuring the schema reflects the current application requirements.
responsibilities: Modify the existing database column corresponding to the Dataset.status field
Preserve existing dataset records during the schema change
Register the schema state change within Django's migration framework
inputs: Previous migration state in the dataset app
Updated Dataset model field definition for status
outputs: Altered database column for dataset status
architecture_notes: This is a standard Django schema migration (AlterField) in the data persistence layer. It follows Django's sequential migration numbering and dependency chain. The migration is typically atomic at the database level and should be reversible. It isolates schema evolution from business logic, keeping the dataset app aligned with its ORM definition.
improvements: Accompany with a data migration if existing status values must be remapped to new choices
Use Django's Choices enumeration (IntegerChoices/TextChoices) for the status field to improve type safety and maintainability
Add a database index on the status column if queries frequently filter by dataset state
Document the meaning and lifecycle rules of each status value in the model or app documentation
Validate that the alteration is backward-compatible with running application instances during deployment
